name: Progress Sidecar
author: CodexStatus
summary: Shows concise progress through a temporary /side-style conversation.

permissions.reason: Read the selected task's local title and observable activity to prepare a progress request.
Create a temporary read-only side conversation without changing the source task.
Use Codex model quota whenever a manual or scheduled progress summary is requested.

privacyDescription: Creates an ephemeral, read-only fork of the selected task. The summary stays in CodexStatus and does not enter the source conversation. Each refresh uses account quota.
